name: GEO-aware SEO article
tagline: Draft a long-form article that ranks in classic search AND gets cited by LLM answer engines — clear standalone claims, quotable definitions, explicit FAQ blocks, one idea per heading.
description: How to draft a long-form SEO article that is also GEO-aware (Generative Engine Optimization): structured so both a search-snippet extractor AND an LLM answering a question can lift a clean, self-contained claim from it. Covers the article skeleton (title + meta description pair, scannable H2/H3 sections, a definition paragraph, an FAQ block of real question headings with quotable one-paragraph answers, outbound reference links), the claim-writing discipline (each key sentence stands alone, no anaphora-only reference, no invented facts), the reading-level target, and the length window. Folded into the drafting prompt by the seo-article route (research -> outline -> draft) via the #515 guideline-fold path.
